label: Nov 2026
html: ReWY is now available! It streamlines Delta-Rule Attention backpropagation in hybrid models, reducing local WY backward matrix multiplications from 7 to 3 and reusing shared gradient intermediates. It accelerates DeltaNet, GDN, KDA, and GDN2 operators by 1.25–2.89× on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. The paper and code are publicly available—give it a try! Paper · Code.
performance_note: The 1.25–2.89× range is the owner-provided summary for this news item. The current arXiv v2 abstract reports platform- and policy-specific ranges (GPU 1.15–1.81×; Ascend 1.09–2.89×). Do not treat these benchmark scopes as identical.

label: Aug 2026
html: OLED-MoE has been accepted to EuroSys 2027. Congratulations to Jingyuan and Jiayue! For memory-constrained MoE-based diffusion LLMs, it exploits expert locality across adjacent denoising iterations to predict and retain high-value experts, reducing CPU–GPU transfers and cache thrashing for faster inference. The paper and code are publicly available. Paper · Code.

html: PAT will appear at ASPLOS 2026. Congratulations to Jinjun and Zhixin! PAT exploits hierarchical shared prefixes to eliminate redundant KV-cache reads during decoding, easing memory-bandwidth pressure and reducing time per output token (TPOT). Its vLLM-compatible plugin can be enabled with a one-line change. The paper and code are publicly available. Paper · Code · Slides.
integration_note: The public README describes one-line environment-variable configuration after plugin installation; the news uses “one-line change” rather than claiming a new application API.
